title: The Thorn of Ironhollow
premise: Petra Okafor has spent nine years as the crown's food-taster, swallowing poison in measured doses while secretly building an immunity that is itself a form of the forbidden gift. When King Aldric declares a realm-wide hunt for gift-bearers, Petra's carefully invisible life shatters: his immunity marks him, and the smuggler roads he knows become both escape route and trap. Fleeing into Thornfell with a half-dead dragon named Vessal whose fire is guttering, Petra learns the taster's guild has been dosing him for years to harvest gift-blood for the king's immortality elixir. In the end Petra chooses to give his blood freely—not to the king but to Vessal—rekindling dragon-fire and exposing the crown's crime, at the cost of his own immunity and any safe place in Ironhollow; he leaves as something new: the first of a bonded line between humans and dragons.
about_author: Wendell Zhou is the pen name of a former line cook who spent a decade in mountain-town kitchens before turning to fantasy. They write about people whose survival depends on what they can stomach.

chapters.title: The Taster's Spoon
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. A routine tasting at court—petty treason in a stew pot—establishes his methodical immunity-building and his rule of invisibility. He notices a new bitterness in the wine he alone samples and pockets a vial. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath practiced calm.

chapters.title: The Proclamation
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The king announces the Gift-Hunt from the balcony; criers offer silver for names. Petra watches a kitchen boy dragged away and realizes his own immunity would read as the gift if tested. He burns his mother's letters. Emotional beat: the floor dropping out of a careful life.

chapters.title: Salt and Silver
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. He plans escape through the Thornfell passes he mapped as a smuggler's runner, bribing gate-captain Ilsa with salt and secrets. She warns him the taster's guild keeps ledgers on every swallow he's taken. Emotional beat: bargaining with the past.

chapters.title: What the Ledgers Say
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Corvane's POV. Corvane reviews nine years of Petra's dosing records—the elixir program needs one more harvest—and orders riders to intercept him before he crosses the pass. Emotional beat: cold, proprietary menace.

chapters.title: The Hollow Road
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Flight through fog-choked ravines; he uses old smuggler caches and nearly dies at a rockslide he once helped rig. He finds scorched earth and enormous tracks. Emotional beat: exhilaration curdling into fear.

chapters.title: Vessal
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. In a collapsed mine he finds Vessal, an ancient dragon dimming toward death, too weak to burn. She smells the poisons in his blood and speaks his name—a name no one living should know. Emotional beat: awe and terror entwined.

chapters.title: The Bargain of Breath
chapters.summary: Vessal's POV (first dragon POV). Vessal explains the bond: dragon-fire once kept the gift alive in human bloodlines; its dying is why gifts fade. She offers truth; Petra offers nothing yet. Emotional beat: reluctant intimacy across species.

chapters.title: Hunters at the Ford
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Guild riders corner them at the river ford; Petra uses a smuggler's trick—flooding the ford—to save them both, revealing tactical brilliance and deepening his debt to Vessal. First kill. Emotional beat: guilt as tuition.

chapters.title: Ironhollow's Orphans
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. He shelters in Ironhollow village among other hidden gift-bearers: a hearth-witch, a boy who hears iron. For two chapters' worth of days he almost belongs. Emotional beat: the ache of found home.

chapters.title: The Hearth-Witch's Price
chapters.summary: Maren the hearth-witch's POV. Maren recognizes what Petra carries and begs him to leave before he draws the Hunt down on them all; her own daughter was taken years ago. Petra refuses. Emotional beat: love expressed as expulsion.

chapters.title: Betrayal by Bread
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The village baker, terrified for his children, sells their location. Riders come at dawn; the hearth-witch burns herself out holding the pass so others flee. Petra escapes with the iron-hearing boy, Tam. Emotional beat: survivor's shame.

chapters.title: Corvane's Cage
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Interrogating captured villagers, Corvane confirms Petra is the final ingredient and learns of Vessal—news that reaches the king, who wants not just elixir but a dragon's heart. Emotional beat: ambition outrunning cruelty.

chapters.title: The Guttering
chapters.summary: Vessal's POV. Vessal is failing faster; she confesses the last dragon-fire dies within a season, and with it every gift in the realm—including whatever keeps Petra alive against poison. Emotional beat: mortality shared.

chapters.title: Tam's Map
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. The boy hears the mountains themselves and leads them to a hidden forge-city where dragons were once bonded with humans. Ruins, murals, and a cracked bonding-stone show what was lost. Emotional beat: grief as inheritance.

chapters.title: The Elixir Revealed
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Deciphering guild documents Tam found, Petra understands the full horror: his nine years of dosing were cultivation; the king drinks refined gift-blood to extend his reign. His body is a vintage. Emotional beat: violation and fury.

chapters.title: What Belonging Costs
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Cornered between surrendering himself to save hunted villagers or running, Petra chooses to send Tam ahead with proof of the elixir while he returns to be taken—bait to draw Corvane from Ironhollow. Emotional beat: belonging finally chosen, at maximum price.

chapters.title: The King's Cellar
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, captive. In the palace undercrofts Petra faces Aldric, who offers partnership: taster and king, immortal together. Petra stalls, tasting the elixir batch and secretly poisoning it with the one compound his immunity taught him to carry. Emotional beat: the taster's art turned to weapon.

chapters.title: Fire Remembers
chapters.summary: Vessal's POV. Dying, Vessal feels Petra's deliberate act through their nascent bond and crawls skyward on ruined wings toward the capital, buying time with her last strength as alarms rise. Emotional beat: sacrifice answering sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Last Toast
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. At the royal banquet, Aldric drinks the tainted elixir before the court; Corvane, realizing too late, tries to silence Petra publicly. Petra instead testifies—every ledger, every stolen child—as the king sickens. Guards waver between crowns and truth. Emotional beat: the invisible man made unignorable.

chapters.title: Dragonfire Reborn
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs converging. Vessal crashes into the palace square; Petra gives his blood freely at the bonding-stone fragment Tam brought, rekindling her fire as the elixir's corruption kills Aldric. The gift passes visibly into the crowd—into Tam, into survivors. Emotional beat: transfiguration through giving rather than taking.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Ledger
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Aftermath: Corvane tried by the very villagers he hunted; the guild dissolved; Petra's immunity gone—he can be poisoned now like anyone, and he finds the vulnerability strangely freeing. Vessal lives, diminished but burning. Emotional beat: mourning and lightness together.

chapters.title: The First Bonded
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, epilogue tone. Spring in rebuilt Ironhollow; Petra trains the first bonded generation, Tam among them, mapping not smuggler roads but flight paths. He plants thorn roses over the old guildhouse. Final beat: belonging earned, inheritance rewritten, survival repurposed into stewardship.
